rule_outs: Dwelling 9 m from the best section
summary: Kerb running into a junction with a painted island, no cars parked, houses 10 m away.
reasons: No cars parked on this side
Houses 10-11 m away at both ends

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 10-11 m from the kerb at the top and bottom ends; the middle has a grassy block but houses overlook it.
drivers.access_and_room: Lane marked for turning at the junction; no pull-in or verge beside the kerb, and No Stopping Any Time signs on this stretch.
drivers.traffic: Collector street with moving and turning traffic into the junction.
drivers.convention: Cars park only on the opposite side, further up the street; none on this kerb.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs and school-day bus zone on the kerb
sun_shade: Mostly open, with trees to the east giving morning shade at the lower end.
